name: FERPA school official data privacy agreements

tasks.name: Execute a written data privacy agreement for each institution
tasks.description: Maintain a signed contract (or equivalent legal instrument) with every educational institution that establishes the direct-control requirement, authorized purposes, use/redisclosure prohibitions, security obligations, audit rights, and return/destruction terms. Confirm the provider is named as a school official with legitimate educational interest in the institution's annual FERPA notification.

requested-evidences.name: Signed school official / data privacy agreement

tasks.name: Maintain a register of institutional agreements
tasks.description: Keep an inventory of all institutions served, the executed agreement, its effective dates, and the authorized purpose, so direct control can be demonstrated on audit.

name: Data minimization and PII scoping for education records

tasks.name: Inventory student PII and limit it to the contracted function
tasks.description: Document every category of student PII (direct identifiers, indirect identifiers, and metadata generated by student interaction) collected or processed, and confirm each element is strictly necessary for the contracted institutional function. Remove or stop collecting anything beyond that scope.

requested-evidences.name: Student PII data inventory / data map

tasks.name: Implement safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of education records
tasks.description: Maintain administrative, physical, and technical controls (encryption in transit/at rest, least-privilege access, authentication, logging) that protect education records against unauthorized access, use, modification, or destruction. Restrict internal access on a need-to-know basis.

requested-evidences.name: Security controls overview / access control matrix

tasks.name: Conduct periodic security risk assessments
tasks.description: Perform and document periodic risk assessments that identify and remediate vulnerabilities affecting systems holding student PII.

tasks.name: Maintain an incident response and breach notification plan
tasks.description: Keep a written incident response plan covering detection, containment, institution notification without undue delay, breach description, and remediation. Define the notification content (nature, categories/volume of records, likely consequences, measures taken) and support the institution's downstream notification obligations.

tasks.name: Establish a prior-notice process for material changes
tasks.description: Define and document a process to notify institutions in advance of material changes to terms of service, privacy policy, data processing practices, security controls, or subprocessors, and to obtain consent where required.

name: Purpose limitation and prohibition on advertising use

tasks.name: Document and enforce authorized-use restrictions
tasks.description: Maintain a policy and technical controls ensuring student PII is used only for the authorized purpose, with explicit prohibitions on marketing/advertising, targeted advertising, sale/licensing of student data, commercial profiling, and content scanning for advertising.

requested-evidences.name: Authorized-use / acceptable-use policy for student data

name: Govern AI and automated processing of student data

tasks.name: Restrict AI/ML processing to the authorized purpose
tasks.description: Configure AI/ML and automated processing so student PII is not used to train models for purposes outside the contracted function. Document zero-data-retention arrangements with AI subprocessors and disclose AI subprocessors that process student PII.

name: Support institutional access and amendment requests

tasks.name: Enable timely retrieval of education records
tasks.description: Maintain a process and data structures that let the institution retrieve student PII fast enough to meet its 45-day (or shorter, per state law) obligation to respond to parental / eligible-student access and amendment requests.

name: Disclosure log and handling of legal process

tasks.name: Maintain a record of disclosures
tasks.description: Keep a documented log of all disclosures of student PII to third parties (including subprocessors): date, recipient, and purpose, sufficient for the institution to account for disclosures.

tasks.name: Define handling of court orders and subpoenas
tasks.description: Document the procedure to notify the institution in advance of complying with a court order or subpoena (unless prohibited), and to coordinate before disclosing education records.

tasks.name: Maintain a subprocessor inventory with flow-down terms
tasks.description: Keep an up-to-date inventory of all subprocessors with access to student PII (function, categories of PII, location) and ensure each is contractually bound by use/redisclosure and protection terms equivalent to the provider's.

tasks.name: Perform subprocessor due diligence
tasks.description: Document due diligence on each subprocessor's security and data-protection posture before engagement and periodically thereafter.

tasks.name: Define a retention schedule and destruction process
tasks.description: Document a retention schedule limiting each category of student PII to the duration necessary for the contracted function, and a destruction process (covering copies, backups, and subprocessors) that renders data unrecoverable, with written certification of destruction on contract end.

tasks.name: Document the de-identification methodology
tasks.description: If retaining derived data after termination, document a de-identification methodology that removes all direct and indirect identifiers and contractually prohibits re-identification by downstream recipients.

tasks.name: Maintain and review security and privacy policies
tasks.description: Keep written information security and privacy policies governing student PII, reviewed at least annually or on significant change, and available to institutions on request.

tasks.name: Deliver FERPA training at onboarding and annually
tasks.description: Train all personnel, contractors, and agents with access to student PII on FERPA scope, authorized use, redisclosure prohibitions, security obligations, and incident reporting; refresh at least annually.

name: Privacy impact assessments for student data

tasks.name: Conduct privacy impact assessments for new processing
tasks.description: Perform and document privacy impact assessments (or equivalent risk evaluations) when introducing new processing, systems, or technologies involving student PII, including AI/automated decision-making.

tasks.name: Maintain and test a business continuity / disaster recovery plan
tasks.description: Keep a documented BC/DR plan covering systems that store or process student PII (RTO/RPO, tested backups/restoration, institution notification of disruptions), tested at least annually with documented results.

requested-evidences.name: Business continuity & disaster recovery plan & test results
